source.label: Eurostat EU-SILC 2022
filters: Source includes print, ebooks and audiobooks; excludes school textbooks/work manuals.
Germany is missing/unreliable; null is retained. Survey year 2022, not current reading habits.
EU benchmark is an official aggregate, not the average of countries. Flags e indicate estimated values.
Aggregate survey results do not provide enough design information to calculate valid confidence intervals here.

metricDefinitions.label: Participation (%)
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 minus the percentage reporting zero books in the past 12 months; all formats include audio. Age 16+, unless a displayed subgroup is selected.

evidenceFlow.title: Population and limits
evidenceFlow.detail: Source includes print, ebooks and audiobooks; excludes school textbooks/work manuals. Germany is missing/unreliable; null is retained. Survey year 2022, not current reading habits. EU benchmark is an official aggregate, not the average of countries. Flags e indicate estimated values. Aggregate survey results do not provide enough design information to calculate valid confidence intervals here.

methods.code: Select n_book=0, unit=PC; participation=100-value. Baseline: sex=T, age=Y_GE16, isced11=TOTAL. Exclude geographic aggregates from country rankings. Preserve missing and u flags.

rows.title: EU-SILC book participation / ilc_scp27
rows.evidence_locator: Dataset dimensions, all observed values and status flags downloaded
rows.comparability_notes: All book formats including audio; excludes school/work manuals. Missing values preserved. No print/audio split.
rows.next_action: Check national notes and status flags before ranking

rows.title: Book formats 2011–2025
rows.evidence_locator: Chart Data table and methodology note
rows.comparability_notes: Partial books included; formats overlap. Phone through 2021; web/phone in 2025.
rows.next_action: Retain method break in trend charts

rows.title: Les Français et la lecture 2025
rows.evidence_locator: 2025 original report p.8 methods; p.20 D4 explicit annual audiobook 15%; p.34 A2 genre table
rows.comparability_notes: France age 15+, n=1001, CATI 21 January to 4 February 2025, published 8 April 2025. Audio annual listening 15% is separate from ever-listened 32%. Genres are paper or digital book categories among all respondents, multiple response, past 12 months. Original categories preserved; no all-country rank.
rows.next_action: Monitor next biennial survey and preserve population and question changes

rows.title: Mediebarometern 2022–2025
rows.evidence_locator: Official annual results summary; book-reading section; explicit prose percentages
rows.comparability_notes: Daily reach, not annual participation. Overlapping formats. Representative random sample ages 9–85; around 6,600 responses for 2022 and around 6,000 for 2023–2025 (rounded publisher descriptions). Fieldwork contractor changed from Origo Group in 2022 to Indikator from 2023. No comparable 2026 annual observation published as of review 2026-10-08.
rows.next_action: Monitor annual official releases; verify explicit audio measure and population before adding a wave

rows.title: Norsk mediebarometer 2025; historical audiobook table 2022–2025
rows.evidence_locator: Printed p.154 (PDF index 153); Table 15.4; Andel lesere / Papirbok or E-bok column, historical year row
rows.comparability_notes: Whole-population daily reach. Overlapping formats. Audiobooks use Table 11.4, not the audio-media-listener denominator in Table 11.5; print and ebook use Table 15.4. No upper age limit from 2022; questionnaire and data-collection changes in 2022 limit comparison with earlier years. 2022–2025 directly printed together in latest corrected report published 2026-05-12. Sweden retains an upper age limit of 85 and uses a separate survey; country level differences are descriptive and do not establish investment priority. No comparable 2026 annual observation published as of review 2026-10-08.
rows.next_action: Monitor annual official releases; verify explicit audio measure and population before adding a wave

rows.title: Canadian Leisure & Reading Studies 2024–2025
rows.population: English-speaking Canadian adult internet-panel readers; separate unweighted waves (2024 reader n=1,000; 2025 reader n=1,005)
rows.evidence_locator: 2025 report p.4 methods, p.25 format reach, p.35 fiction and p.37 nonfiction; 2024 observations retain their own original locators
rows.comparability_notes: Opt-in incentivized online samples. 2025 fieldwork January2026, publication2026-05-05; newly discovered2026-10-12. Reader reach is not all-adult reach. Formats overlap. Exact genre subgroup bases/routing unpublished. Separate annual panel samples; no inferred significance or design confidence intervals. 2024 observations and sample are retained.
rows.next_action: Seek exact format-specific genre bases; retain panel and multiple-response caveats

rows.title: Retratos da Leitura no Brasil 2024
rows.population: Age 5+; exact wave population to verify
rows.evidence_locator: Publisher editions page, survey overview; CBL partner description
rows.comparability_notes: Includes children; recall window must be verified in original 2024 report. Genre evidence is report scope, not extracted measures.
rows.next_action: Review original 2024 definition and genre denominators

rows.title: MOLEC 2025
rows.population: Literate Mexico residents aged 12+; book reader subset for genres; 4818 sampled dwellings is not subgroup n
rows.evidence_locator: Report 45/25 pp.2 to 5 methods; p.11 Figure 7 book types among book readers
rows.comparability_notes: Published 18 November 2025; fieldwork 2 to 27 June 2025, face to face. 4818 sampled dwellings is not the reader denominator. Multiple response. Original Spanish categories retained. Includes educational and professional categories; no audiobook genre split. New national age 12+ series in 2025 replaces prior urban age 18+ scope. Do not join into previous series.
rows.next_action: Monitor next national release; retain 2025 population and method break

rows.title: National Reading Habits Study on Adults 2024
rows.evidence_locator: PDF pp.4–9 methods; pp.40–50 genres and books/formats
rows.comparability_notes: B14 formats: remembered-book subset n=2,693. B9 fiction genres: general readers n=3,657 across websites/social media/books/magazines; not book-only. Prefer 2018 trend baseline.
rows.next_action: Keep B14 book-reader formats separate from B9 mixed-material genres; extract 2018 only after review

rows.title: National Reading Survey 2023
rows.evidence_locator: Findings report and survey methodology description
rows.comparability_notes: Reading broadly covers multiple materials and languages; book-specific questions need separation. No separate audio measure confirmed.
rows.next_action: Review book/genre questions and survey weighting

rows.title: Creative Transformations: Results of the National Arts Participation Survey
rows.population: Australian population age 15+; nationally weighted survey
rows.recall_period: Past 12 months; excludes work or study
rows.access: Public original report and data tables
rows.evidence_locator: Printed p.173 (PDF index 174), Figure 59, Australians engagement with books by year; exact question and both wave n below figure; methods pp.16-19
rows.comparability_notes: Reviewed 2026-10-25. Published 2026-06-03. Both observations are printed together in the 2026 report. Past 12 months at fieldwork, not the whole calendar year. Reading for pleasure excludes work or study. Overlapping formats and book forms. The 2025 sample is mainly online with geographic boosts and 68 focused First Nations interviews; weighted by age, gender and location. Do not compare directly with other countries or infer market share.
rows.next_action: Monitor next wave; preserve exact population, question and report vintage

rows.title: Stan czytelnictwa w Polsce 2024
rows.evidence_locator: Publisher 2024 report page and series methodology page
rows.comparability_notes: Annual and genre definitions to verify; overlaps with Eurostat but year/method differ.
rows.next_action: Read original 2024 questionnaire and tables

rows.title: Hábitos de Lectura y Compra de Libros en España 2025
rows.provider: FGEE / Conecta, with CEDRO sponsorship and Ministry of Culture collaboration
rows.evidence_locator: Printedp57, PDFpage48; total9.0 and2018–2025 retrospective series
rows.comparability_notes: Usual audiobook use; no explicit annual recall. Retrospective 2022 to 2025 observations from 2025 report vintage, published 22 January 2026. Retain reported 2025 total 9.0; components 6.2+2.5=8.7 use different precision. Full fieldwork and collection mode unavailable in hosted report; no inferred trend growth.
rows.next_action: Obtain complete methodological annex and clarify aggregate precision before any derived analysis

rows.title: Survey on Time Use and Leisure Activities 2021
rows.evidence_locator: Official survey outline
rows.comparability_notes: Reading-specific table not yet reviewed. Diary minutes cannot substitute for annual book participation.
rows.next_action: Find book-specific leisure participation tables

rows.title: National Youth Readership Survey
rows.population: Youth only; exact literacy/age coverage to verify
rows.access: Publisher catalogue; full data access unconfirmed
rows.evidence_locator: Official catalogue confirms survey/report existence
rows.comparability_notes: Historical youth study; not national adult prevalence. 2010 study cited in ministry policy; catalogue date is not survey year.
rows.next_action: Find original study and a more recent nationally representative source

rows.title: Arab Reading Index 2016
rows.evidence_locator: Publisher page and Knowledge4All project description
rows.comparability_notes: Regional candidate only; not assigned to individual countries until country scope and sampling are checked.
rows.next_action: Inspect original report and sample selection before binding countries

rows.title: The 2026 Story Report
rows.population: Online panels age 18–79; listener eligibility and subgroup n unpublished
rows.evidence_locator: PDF pages 13–14 printed top-five percentages; methods in report and publisher release
rows.comparability_notes: Common questions across five countries; listener-only preferences and occasions. Top five only, unlisted is unreported. No total-population audio percentages extracted; no survey-design CI available. Commissioned by Storytel.
rows.next_action: Validate listener filters and obtain subgroup sizes before inferential comparisons; retain sponsor disclosure

rows.title: APA annual audiobook publisher sales 2022–2025
rows.provider: Audio Publishers Association / Harris Interactive / Toluna
rows.population: APA-member audiobook publishers; 28 respondents for 2022, 27 for 2023; later public response counts unavailable
rows.access: Public association releases; 2022/2023 APA-issued releases hosted by PRWeb
rows.evidence_locator: Annual releases; exact per-row URL and release date in industry_metrics.csv
rows.comparability_notes: Publisher revenue, not people or retail consumer spending. USD current-price amounts, rounded. Participation may change. Do not infer audio share by dividing APA receipts by AAP modeled publishing totals. Observation years 2022–2025.
rows.next_action: Refresh public release annually and retain prior evidence URLs; use matched publisher panels for growth where possible

rows.title: AAP StatShot Annual book and course-material revenue 2022–2025
rows.provider: Association of American Publishers / MPI / Industry Insights
rows.population: US book and course-material publishing industry; survey plus market-model estimates; not consumer respondents
rows.access: Public association releases; full harmonized reports require purchase and were not accessed
rows.evidence_locator: Opening revenue paragraph and Methodology in each annual release; per-row URL and date in industry_metrics.csv
rows.comparability_notes: As-published estimates from different release vintages. 2023-method change recalculated prior years; later reports collect and restate five years. 2023 originally $29.9B, revised to $31.3B in 2024 release. Public exact latest-vintage 2022/2023 unavailable. No continuous growth/CAGR, no confidence intervals inferred. Includes academic course materials, excludes journals, not print-only.
rows.next_action: Retain vintage labels; obtain publicly released same-vintage history before growth analysis

rows.title: UK Publishers Association consumer audio and print publisher revenue 2022–2025
rows.population: UK consumer-sector publishers; home-market sales plus exports; not UK-resident consumer respondents
rows.access: Public association releases and one-page summary PDFs
rows.evidence_locator: Consumer publishing sections in four annual releases; 2025 one-page PDF Consumer panel visually checked; per-row evidence in industry_metrics.csv
rows.comparability_notes: As-published GBP revenue across changing release vintages. Older pages warn figures are out of date after revisions. 2024 original audio £268M versus 2025 £255M with reported +10% proves a vintage break. No continuous growth or CAGR. Consumer scope excludes education/academic publishing and journals; exports included. Audience is not measured.
rows.next_action: Use latest matched-vintage publisher data for growth; preserve older releases only as dated estimates

rows.title: Audible Compass 2025: audiobook genres in four European countries
rows.provider: Audible / Verian, published by authorized PR agency BUCH CONTACT
rows.population: Online panel age 18 to 65, audiobook listeners in past 12 months; exact listener subgroup sizes unpublished
rows.access: Public original infographic and methodology press release
rows.evidence_locator: Infographic PDF p.2 genre chart and footnote; methodology release PDF p.4
rows.comparability_notes: Commissioned by Audible, conducted by Verian in July 2025, published 13 October 2025. About 1000 respondents per country; that total is not the genre subgroup base. Multiple answers. Combined audiobook, audio drama and podcast reach headlines are excluded. Listener preferences do not measure national adoption.
rows.next_action: Seek eligible listener subgroup counts and monitor the next study

rows.title: Books reading, borrowing and buying: regular study 75, 2026
rows.provider: KVB Boekwerk / Stichting Marktonderzoek Boekenvak / NIQ GfK
rows.population: Netherlands age 14+, online panel, 2026 n=1200, weighted sex/age/education
rows.evidence_locator: Printed p.24 D05; p.5 population; p.72 methodology
rows.comparability_notes: 2026 report vintage published June 2026. 2026 fieldwork 19 January to 2 February, CAWI online panel n=1200, weighted sex/age/education. Earlier sample n printed in retrospective chart; detailed earlier designs not reverified. Weekly frequency is not annual listening. Store explicit weekly bars only: rounded weekly, less often and never segments do not always sum to 100. Exclude reconstructed any-listening totals and inconsistent genre table p.56.
rows.next_action: Seek correction of genre table p.56 and reconciliation of any-listening totals; weekly figures retained

rows.title: YouGov Survey: 2025 Reading and Books
rows.population: U.S. citizens age 18+; opt-in weighted online panel
rows.access: Public original report and data tables
rows.evidence_locator: Printed p.12 (PDF index 19), Q9 Book Genres Read, Total column; question base printed p.13 (PDF index 20); methodology printed p.51 (PDF index 58)
rows.comparability_notes: Reviewed 2026-10-25. Published 2025-12-31. Fieldwork 15-19 December 2025; question refers to 2025 to date, not a completed calendar year or rolling past 12 months. Target is U.S. adult citizens, excluding noncitizen residents. Opt-in online panel weighted to citizen demographics and political variables. Multiple responses; percentages are population participation, not reader-only preferences or revenue shares. Keep separate from Pew adult-population observations. Table base n=2,201; overall sample n=2,203.
rows.next_action: Monitor next wave; preserve exact population, question and report vintage

rows.title: Audio listening in the UK 2026
rows.population: UK adults16+; weighted online Yonder sample n3469
rows.evidence_locator: Printedp4 Figure1; Q1 weekly reach includes audiobooks as own type
rows.comparability_notes: Direct PDF/XLSX downloads403Cloudflare; webPDFtext available but Figure1label-to-series not visually validated. Do not ingest guessed audiopercentages.
rows.next_action: Retrieve original tables and resolve measurement base before adding numeric rows

rows.title: National Reading Survey 2025
rows.provider: Read NZ Te Pou Muramura / Horizon Research
rows.population: NZ adults18+; weighted online panels n1024; March17-23,2025
rows.evidence_locator: Printedp15/PDFindex16 fiction table; printedp17/PDFindex18 nonfiction table
rows.comparability_notes: Genre table All Readers, percentages sum selections from10%-100%scale; exact questionnaire/routing not included.; Audio summary43%readerbase differs from40%audio onprintedp14 and60%never onprintedp38 total sample. Hold audio until source clarifies bases.
rows.next_action: Retrieve original tables and resolve measurement base before adding numeric rows

rows.title: AJPEA paper books and electronic book/comic sales 2022-2025
rows.provider: All Japan Magazine and Book Publishers and Editors Association / Research Institute for Publications
rows.population: AJPEA estimated Japanese publication sales, with separate paper book, electronic book and electronic comic categories; not consumer respondents
rows.access: Public original association press release PDF
rows.evidence_locator: One-page26 January 2026 release, bottom historical table;2022-2025 book and electronic categories
rows.comparability_notes: All selected years use one 2026 winter report vintage. Currency is JPY; original100-million-JPY units rescaled to JPY million without FX conversion. Paper magazines and electronic magazines excluded. Audiobooks not identified. Price/tax basis is not specified in public release. No country ranking or inferred growth.
rows.next_action: Check the next annual original report and retain classification and vintage notes

rows.title: KVB Boekwerk 2025 retail market monitor monetary history
rows.population: Extrapolated Netherlands general-book retail panel covering physical and ecommerce channels; not consumer survey respondents
rows.access: Public monitor and its publisher-linked Infogram data
rows.evidence_locator: Linked Markt2025 Verkoopcijfers figure, Omzet sheet,2022-2025; methodology under Marktmonitor verantwoording
rows.comparability_notes: EUR million gross general-book retail sales values. Includes individually purchased Dutch ebooks and some monitored non-book categories; excludes subscriptions, streaming and publisher non-retail sales.2025 panel expansion revised2023 onward; do not infer continuous growth from2022. Monitor updated in February 2026; exact update day is not stated.
rows.next_action: Monitor latest report and panel methodology; retain revisions and scope

rows.title: French SNE publisher revenue, 2025–2026 report vintage
rows.population: French book publishing survey; about 150 publishing houses, approximately 500 brands stated in the report; paper and digital publisher activity net of returns and discounts; publisher-origin scope includes domestic and export activity
rows.access: Public statistical synthesis PDF and official release
rows.evidence_locator: Printed pp.2–3 (PDF pages 3–4), Graphique 1 and Tableau1; methods paragraph printedp.2
rows.comparability_notes: Publisher net revenue including rights and book-sales-only revenue are separate overlapping series. All extracted values from the same 2025–2026 vintage. Not retail consumer spending, not audience participation, and not a separate audiobook revenue measure. The report and release differ in editorial-brand count; do not treat that count as a measured population denominator. Export activity is included in the publisher-origin scope, not confined to purchases by French residents; PDF page 22 uses the same net book-sales total when discussing exports.
rows.next_action: Review next SNE report, preserve report vintage and distinguish rights-inclusive totals from book sales

rows.title: German book trade turnover, 2026 table vintage
rows.population: Estimated German book trade businesses across all distribution channels, including publisher direct sales to private and institutional end customers
rows.access: Public official table compendium and press release
rows.evidence_locator: Printed/PDFp.2, Table 1, Insgesamt row and annual Umsatz in Mio EUR columns
rows.comparability_notes: Estimated turnover at final consumer prices, not publisher net receipts. Same 2026 vintage for 2022–2025. No derived country ranking, foreign currency conversion, market share or audiobook revenue inference. The exact table 2025 value is EUR 9619 million; the press release rounds to EUR9.62billion.
rows.next_action: Review next annual official table and preserve definition, consumer-price basis and revision vintage

rows.title: Spain domestic book market billings, FGEE 2025 advance
rows.provider: Federacion de Gremios de Editores de Espana / Conecta; CEDRO and Ministry of Culture sponsorship
rows.population: Private association-member Spanish publishing companies; 2025 advance describes 862 companies, not a consumer sample; exact responding-company count not extracted
rows.access: Public official advance PDF linked from FGEE studies register
rows.evidence_locator: PDF pages 4, 5, 16 and 20; printed slides 4, 6, 17 and 21; exact row locators in industry_metrics.csv

source.label: Book-market evidence and source freshness
filters: Keep country, question, population and recall period together. Missing survey years stay missing.
Source check time is different from survey year. Public demand data does not establish profitable market entry.

methods.code: Read validated public observations and receipts; filter annual history to 2022 onward. Do not pool incompatible definitions or interpolate unpublished waves.

rows.business_model: Book retail marketplace; ebook subscription; self-publishing and print on demand
rows.geographic_scope: International Amazon marketplaces; title and programme availability varies by territory
rows.notes: Parent-level reporting covers many businesses. Book-specific revenues and subscribers were not extracted. Audible is listed separately; these rows must not be summed.

rows.business_model: Premium audiobook listening allowances; audiobook purchases and add-ons; print referral commerce
rows.geographic_scope: Audiobooks in selected markets; wider rollout announced for completion by end of 2026; print purchases via partner in US and UK
rows.notes: Print means purchases through Bookshop.org, not a Spotify-owned print catalogue. The 7 October 2026 global expansion announcement is a rollout plan, not proof all announced markets are live. Group music and podcast metrics are not audiobook metrics.

rows.business_model: Individual digital book purchases
rows.geographic_scope: Supported countries and regions; ebooks and audiobooks have different availability lists
rows.notes: Official Apple service information documents ebooks and audiobooks. No book-specific subscribers, sales or revenue were extracted; Apple-wide figures are not a substitute.

rows.business_model: Individual digital book purchases; publisher distribution
rows.geographic_scope: Supported countries and territories; sale eligibility and format availability vary
rows.notes: Official table distinguishes purchase, publisher signup and payment eligibility. These are not identical market-presence measures. No book-specific usage or revenue metric was extracted.

rows.business_model: Digital book retail; Kobo Plus subscription in eligible markets; reading devices
rows.geographic_scope: International digital retail; audiobook and Kobo Plus eligibility varies by country
rows.notes: Rakuten parent reporting documents the Kobo business. Reading devices are not print book consumption. Kobo-specific subscriber or format revenue metrics were not extracted.

rows.business_model: Subscription with plan-specific premium title unlocks and a separate unlimited catalogue
rows.geographic_scope: International digital service; territorial catalogue and plan availability require separate review
rows.notes: Everand is the book service within Scribd, Inc.; Scribd's document platform is a different service. Do not treat combined platform users as book readers or audiobook subscribers. No comparable metrics were extracted.

rows.business_model: Book streaming subscription
rows.geographic_scope: European markets, including Nordic and continental European storefronts
rows.notes: The parent publishes a BookBeat business overview and reporting. Subscriber definitions, dates and country scope require metric-by-metric extraction before comparison. No quantities were imported into this register.

rows.business_model: Book streaming subscriptions; publishing and distribution
rows.geographic_scope: Selected international streaming markets and regional publishing businesses

source.label: Published book industry sales and revenue
filters: Keep country, reported currency, measurement scope and report vintage together. Publisher receipts and retail turnover are different measures.
Observation year, publication date and source check time stay separate. Year-only publication dates remain year-only. Missing years are not estimated.
Country totals with different coverage or price bases do not form a market ranking or a common growth series.

methods.code: Read validated public observations and receipts; filter annual history to 2022 onward. Do not pool incompatible definitions or interpolate unpublished waves.

source.label: Eurostat EU-SILC 2022
filters: Source includes print, ebooks and audiobooks; excludes school textbooks/work manuals.
Germany is missing/unreliable; null is retained. Survey year 2022, not current reading habits.
EU benchmark is an official aggregate, not the average of countries. Flags e indicate estimated values.
Aggregate survey results do not provide enough design information to calculate valid confidence intervals here.
